elevenlabsPrompt:
[exasperated] Said five more minutes in bed, and now it's 1 a.m.?

[confident] Here's the fix. Schedule Downtime in Screen Time.

[friendly] Open Settings, then Screen Time. Tap Downtime and switch on Scheduled. Pick the apps that stay on in Always Allowed.

[delighted] At bedtime the other apps grey out, and calls still come through.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
coverLine: Your iPhone can lock apps at bedtime
